title: 1.5.0 release umbrella - the H3 cut on the 1.4.x line, a deviation from the 2.0 roadmap

summary: Phase 2 done and pushed as 2603f668 on branch 1.4.2: MPI-598 (Klein 9B - new model, klein_9b_t2i.json, 9 display webps, the seven-slot style rack), MPI-615 (SDXL/Illustrious/Pony/Krea 2 inpaint on the LanPaint path + krea2Turbo on the op), MPI-609 (style LoRAs named for their labels), MPI-575 (non-Flow half only) and MPI-605 (both LTX runtimes take ModelAttentionBackend - the plan's claim that the node was already on the branch was wrong, only the H3 pair had it). LanPaint added to node_lock, 16 packs; no Flow pack or audio dep crossed. Two commits rode along deliberately: MPI-619 (Klein 4B/9B carry their size in the name - without it 9B debuts under a shared name and the L/B letter, which is how a 9B style LoRA got picked for a 4B run) and c4208de8 (the pod-lock gate stops demanding a rebuild for installRequirements:false nodes - without it the Phase 3 smoke refuses over LanPaint). MPI-575's node_lock hunk was rejected by the 3-way and should have been: it moved MpiNodes BACKWARDS to 5e07043; the pin holds at 287edb83. 659/659 tests, 259/259 dep URLs, eslint clean, smoke --self-check OK.
